name: direct-medical-diagnosis-analysis-care-evidence
policy: Support direct diagnostic analysis, interpretation of clinical evidence and nursing/self-care guidance with current authoritative sources. No multi-stage workflow, expert routing, compute routing or model-selection mechanism is part of this registry.

sources.role: national clinical, care, quality and public-health guidance
medicine and medical-device safety and regulatory information
global disease, treatment, nursing-support and public-health guidance
evidence-based diagnosis, treatment and care guidance
infectious disease, vaccination, prevention and patient-care guidance
medicine and device safety, warnings and regulatory evidence
primary biomedical literature, reviews and case evidence
open full-text biomedical literature where rights permit
biomedical literature and open full text where licensed
structured drug labels, warnings, contraindications and administration information
patient-readable conditions, tests, treatments, medicines and self-care information
trial status and intervention evidence when clinically relevant

evidence_priority: current specialty-society guideline available without paywall
direct_use_rules: State what was directly observed versus inferred.
Do not convert illegible handwriting or uncertain image findings into definite clinical facts.
Rank plausible diagnoses and include evidence for and against the major alternatives.
Check urgency and red flags before reassurance.
Give practical nursing/self-care and follow-up criteria when safe.
Do not invent medicine names, doses or procedures from incomplete records.
When important variables are missing, name the missing variables rather than silently assuming them.
